relationships.subject: high-altitude headache
relationships.evidence_quote: In participants with HAH, increase of tear fluid CGRP was significantly higher compared to participants without HAH

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: This result supports the idea that CGRP release is involved in the pathophysiology of HAH

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Released from trigeminovascular afferents, CGRP acts as a potent vasodilator and proinflammatory mediator and induces headache.

key_findings: Tear fluid CGRP rise was higher in participants with HAH (+1.49 vs -0.42 ng/mL, p=0.011).
CGRP rise was higher with moderate-to-severe and migraine-like headache; no overall change vs baseline.
